Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses LABORATORY ROTARY DIGESTER and BALL MILL (Laborator y Type) LABORATORY ROTARY DIGESTER - 1 no Scope of equipment: The Laboratory Rotary Digester used for cooking of Raw Materials, such as Wood Chips and various Fibrou s materials under specified & controlled conditions of Pressure, Temperature & Time, prior to "Producing the Pulp". Testing Applications: Pulp Testing Raw Material Agro, Fibre (Cooking), Pulp Testing Raw Material Wood Fib re (Cooking) Specification : Capacity: 20 Liters Rotary vessel : material – Stainless Steel should be Acid proof. The Stainless Steel Rotary Vessel has to wit hstand at Pressure up to 15 kg/cm2 & Temperature up to 200°C. Stainless Steel Rotary Vessel should have Perforated Basket inside the Vessel for easy lift and separate th e cooked material from the black liquor, after the cooking is over. The rotations of cooking vessel : provision for change of turning direction should ensure efficient agitation of th e pulp. The Heating should be performed electrically, through a set of jacketed heaters. The vessel's sealing lid should have mounted with safety valve & pressure gauge and provided with Microp rocessor Based Temperature Indicator Cum Controller with facility of more Detailed Pre-Programming to C ontrol the Boiling Sequence. The surface, in contact with the pulp should be made of Acid Proof Stainless Steel. Brief description [ The Rotary Digester is used for cooking of Raw Materials, such as Wood Chips and various Fibrous mat erials under specified & controlled conditions of Pressure, Temperature & Time, prior to "Producing the Pul p". The rotations of cooking vessel with the change of turning direction, ensures efficient agitation of the pulp. The Acid Proof Stainless Steel Rotary Vessel is tested to withstand at Pressure up to 15 kg/cm² & Tempera

ture up to 200°C. The Perforated Basket inside the Vessel enables to easy lift and separate the cooked ma terial from the black liquor, after the cooking is over. The Heating is performed electrically, through a set o f jacketed heaters. The safety valve & pressure gauge are mounted on the vessel's sealing lid and provided with Microprocess or Based Temperature Indicator Cum Controller with facility of more Detailed Pre-Programming to Control t he Boiling Sequence. The surface, in contact with the pulp are made of Acid Proof Stainless Steel. ] BALL MILL (Laboratory Type) : 1 no Scope of equipment: BALL MILL (Laboratory Type) for mixing and grinding electrically operated. Specification : Capacity / Volume : few grams to 1.0 kg and 2.0 kg capacity.. The unit speed : FHP motor - 20 RPM to Max speed 80 RPM, Material of Jar : Aluminum The jar should be interchangeable and easily removable light weight and compact un it. Steel balls of different sizes to be fixed in a jar for mixing and grinding of pesticides p owder. Construction Frame : Heavy-duty powder-coated mild steel or cast structure with l ow-noise operation. BALL MILL (Laboratory Type) Stainless Steel Jar capacity : 5 Kg Jar, rotation type. Motor Power : FHP motor of 1/4 HP Power supply : 220 volts A.C. Main. Single phase. Terms & Conditions: 1. Supplier shall, at its own expense, pack, load, and deliver Goods to the Delivery Poi nt and in accordance with the invoicing, delivery terms, shipping, packing, and other instructions printed on the face of the Purchase Order or otherwise provided to Suppli er by Buyer in writing. 2. No charges will be allowed for freight, transportation, insurance, shipping, storage, handling, demurrage, cartage, packaging or similar charges unless provided for in th e applicable Purchase Order or otherwise agreed to in writing by Buyer. 3.
